in_marathi.name: Bisalesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bisalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bisa: auspicious, prosperous, Veda: knowledge, Sh: Lord. The name Bisalesh is derived from Sanskrit roots, meaning 'Lord of Auspiciousness'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is considered a powerful name for a baby boy.
